newsitem.title: USA: Duchess of York shoots fruit drink commercial.
newsitem.headline: Duchess of York shoots fruit drink commercial.

text.p: Britain's Duchess of York, Sarah Ferguson, who is struggling to wipe out heavy debts, shot a television commercial on Monday endorsing an American fruit drink for which she is reportedly being paid 500,000 pounds ($838,000).

Ferguson filmed the 30-second advertising spot for Ocean Spray cranberry juice in Los Angeles, according to a spokesman at the New York-based public relations firm Howard Rubenstein, which represents her.

"She shot the commercial today, which will air on Jan. 20," the spokesman told Reuters. He said the duchess, whose 10-year marriage to Prince Andrew ended in divorce last year, has attracted serious interest from several U.S. advertisers.
London's Mirror newspaper reported on Monday that Ferguson was being paid 500,000 pounds ($838,000) to make the TV ad.
Officials for Ocean Spray, a household name in juice-making in the United States, were not available for comment.
The ad, which will be shown only in the United States, will show Fergie speaking directly to the camera, the Mirror reported.

The ad marks the first time a British royal is to endorse a product on television, but it is not an advertising debut for the duchess who in early November appeared in a magazine advert for an Olympus digital camera.
That ad was to be carried in magazines appearing in continental Europe, but not in Britain, in a bid to save the duchess' former royal in-laws from embarrassment.

The duchess, commonly known as Fergie, was visiting Los Angeles on Monday with her two daughters. She met with Hollywood executives in December to discuss the possibility of hosting an American television talk show.
